search.title: Get all counties from NewShipRep location table

methods.why: Counties prints county names (countyname plus countyno). That is not a numeric time series. methods.clean drops the rows because they have no period. methods/ was not edited.

notes: Ids are copied from the printed OpenAPI path without a leading slash. access_path is the printed origin + servers[0].url /ws + path. No Kystverket id was written onto a datanorge row.
Fetch GETs the stored collection URL. Observation values are printed countyname. Nested objects such as metadata are not copied as dimensions.
License is the printed OpenAPI NLOD 1.0 URL. Publisher stays null: the spec does not print a publisher field.
JWT-restricted paths such as /api/ship/combined/download were not in the first 10 printed collection GET paths and were not fetched.
